title: A transdiagnostic model of illness awareness and denial: Core components of the broader construct of insight into illness
title_zh: 跨诊断的疾病认知模型：洞察力更广泛构念的核心组成部分
abstract: Insight into illness is a dynamic multidimensional construct that varies between individuals and medical and psychiatric disorders, and influences treatment engagement and clinical outcomes. Despite extensive study, accounts remain fragmented and disorder specific. This review focuses on subjective illness awareness and proposes a hypothesis-generating neurobiological framework in which fluctuations in awareness and denial emerge from interactions among self-representational networks, hierarchical predictive processing, and salience-threat systems that shape the balance between self-model stability and adaptation to illness-related information. Illness-related stimuli generate prediction errors (i.e., mismatches between sensory input and the self-model) that may update higher-order self-beliefs when assigned sufficient precision. Conversely, denial may occur when identity-relevant psychological threat biases precision toward self-related priors, potentially shifting network dynamics toward relatively left-lateralized self-representational states that attenuate discrepant information and preserve psychological homeostasis. This probabilistic model of illness awareness depends on the strength and credibility of illness-related evidence and flexibility of higher-order self-related beliefs. The review specifies falsifiable predictions for hemispheric engagement, threat-related precision weighting, and self-specific belief updating and identifies potential therapeutic targets.
abstract_zh: 疾病洞察力是一个动态的多维构念，在个体间以及医学和精神科疾病间存在差异，并影响治疗依从性和临床结局。尽管已有大量研究，但现有的解释仍然支离破碎且仅限于特定疾病。本综述聚焦于主观疾病认知，并提出一个生成假设的神经生物学框架，其中感知和否认的波动源于自我表征网络、层级预测加工以及显著-威胁系统的相互作用，这些系统共同塑造了自我模型的稳定性与适应疾病相关信息之间的平衡。疾病相关刺激产生预测误差（即感官输入与自我模型之间的不匹配），当这些误差被赋予足够的精确度时，可能会更新高阶自我信念。相反，当与身份相关的心理威胁偏向自我相关先验时，可能会出现否认，从而将网络动力学转向相对左侧侧化的自我表征状态，抑制差异信息并保持心理稳态。该疾病认知的概率模型依赖于疾病相关证据的强度和可信度，以及高阶自我相关信念的灵活性。综述为半球参与、威胁相关的精确度加权以及自我特异性信念更新提出了可证伪的预测，并确定了潜在的治疗靶点。
